scripts.test: sh -c 'rm -rf .test-dist; tsc --ignoreConfig src/hex-math.ts src/viewport.ts src/render-lifecycle.ts src/api.ts src/tool-route.ts src/runtime-view.ts --outDir .test-dist --module ESNext --target ES2022 --moduleResolution Bundler --skipLibCheck; status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then node --test test/hex-math.test.mjs test/render-lifecycle.test.mjs test/tool-host.test.mjs test/tool-route.test.mjs test/contract-source.test.mjs test/runtime-view.test.mjs; status=$?; fi; rm -rf .test-dist; exit $status'
scripts.build: npm run test && npm run typecheck && vite build
